objectives.statement: Understand foundational mental models and architecture of JavaScript
Implement secure, reproducible solutions across real-world JavaScript tasks
Diagnose common production edge cases, bottlenecks, and vulnerabilities in JavaScript
Architect scalable enterprise workflows aligned with JavaScript industry best practices

prerequisites: Familiarity with web browser developer tools (Console, Network, Sources tab)

modules.title: Module 1: V8 Engine Internals, Scope Chain & Execution Contexts
modules.summary: Understand the V8 JavaScript engine, memory heap, call stack, execution context phases, hoisting, TDZ, and lexical closures.
lessonTitles: V8 Engine Internals, Call Stack & Execution Contexts
Lexical Scope Chain, Variable Lifetimes & Closures
modules.checkpoint: Analyze call stack execution frames, Temporal Dead Zone boundaries, and closure memory retention.

modules.title: Module 2: Asynchronous Event Loop & Concurrency Architecture
modules.summary: Explore the single-threaded event loop, call stack, macrotask vs microtask queues, Promise internals, and async/await error pipelines.
lessonTitles: Macrotasks, Microtasks & The Event Loop Architecture
modules.checkpoint: Trace execution ordering between microtasks and macrotasks and build cancelable async pipelines.

modules.title: Module 3: Prototypal Systems, Modern Modules & Web Architecture
modules.summary: Understand prototype delegation, ES6 classes, static resolution of ES Modules, tree shaking, and memory leak prevention.
lessonTitles: Prototypes, Object Delegation & ES6 Class Systems
ES Modules, Tree Shaking & High-Performance Architecture
modules.checkpoint: Implement prototype-delegated event emitters and build tree-shakeable modular components.

practiceActivities: Profile execution contexts, call stacks, and closure memory retention in Chrome DevTools Memory profiler
Implement an unhandled rejection watchdog and async concurrency pool with Promise.allSettled and AbortController
Architect a high-performance EventEmitter implementing prototypal delegation and WeakMap private encapsulation
Build a production-grade Tree-Shakeable ES Module with automated unit tests using Vitest
assessmentCheckpoints: Module 1: V8 Engine Internals, Scope Chain & Execution Contexts Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
Module 2: Asynchronous Event Loop & Concurrency Architecture Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
Module 3: Prototypal Systems, Modern Modules & Web Architecture Checkpoint (70% pass threshold)
projects: Enterprise Real-Time Event Dispatcher & Asynchronous Data Pipeline Engine
proficiencyCriteria: Explain V8 engine execution phases: Ignition bytecode interpreter, TurboFan JIT compiler, and Hidden Classes
Predict microtask vs macrotask execution order across Promise resolutions, queueMicrotask, and setTimeout
Prevent memory leaks caused by closures, detached DOM trees, and orphaned event listeners
Design asynchronous workflows with cancelable AbortSignal tokens and deterministic error boundaries
